lines.en: : No thank you. I’m going to walk down the street waving it around and proclaiming my love for the girl it’s for.
lines.zh: : 不用了，谢谢。我要拿着它上街挥舞，向它要送给的那个女孩宣告我的爱。

lines.en: : And who may I ask is this for, sir?
lines.zh: : 那我能否请教，这是送给谁的，先生？
: Yumi Yamaguchi。1-A 班。

lines.en: : I know what fucking class she’s in! It’s mine!
lines.zh: : 我知道她他妈在哪个班！就在我班上！

lines.en: : And like hell I’d believe you’d buy something like this for {i}her{/i} of all people!
lines.zh: : 而且我死也不信你会买这种东西送给{i}她{/i}——送谁不好偏偏是她！

lines.en: : You’re right. It’s actually for you.
lines.zh: : 你说得对。其实是送给你的。
: 那有什么好的？！

lines.en: : This is the last thing I want for Christmas!
lines.zh: : 这是我圣诞节最不想要的东西！

lines.en: : Aww, nuts. Did Sensei steal my Christmas present idea?
lines.zh: : 哎呀，糟糕。老师抢了我的圣诞礼物创意吗？

lines.en: : I had one wrapped up and everything.
lines.zh: : 我都已经包装好了呢。

lines.en: : What kind of horrible mother would buy something like this for her daughter? Just what kind of monster do you think I am?
lines.zh: : 什么样的可怕母亲会给自己女儿买这种东西？你到底把我想成什么怪物了？

lines.en: : Are you upset because you don’t know how to use it? I know it might look intimidating, but with a little bit of effort-
lines.zh: : 你是不是因为不会用才生气？我知道它看着可能有点吓人，不过只要稍微努力一下——
: 你到底想怎样，妈？

lines.en: : All I want is for my daughter to be happy. And if that means teaching her how to use-
lines.zh: : 我只想要我女儿幸福。如果那意味着教她怎么使用——

lines.en: : Here! You have it if you like it so much!
lines.zh: : 给！你这么喜欢就自己留着吧！

lines.en: : Go get me a normal present like a...phone charm! Or a book!
lines.zh: : 去给我买件正常的礼物，比如……手机挂件！或者一本书！

lines.en: : But dear, I already have this one. And while the idea of two of them isn’t {i}entirely{/i} out of the question, I don’t think-
lines.zh: : 可是亲爱的，我已经有这个了。虽然来两个也不是{i}完全{/i}不行，但我觉得——

lines.en: : Do you see what you’ve done?
lines.zh: : 看看你干的好事？

lines.en: : Oh my. I forgot you were there for a moment. How do you do, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 哎呀。我都忘了你还在旁边呢。你好吗，老师？

lines.en: : I’m fine. My pants seem to keep getting tighter, though.
lines.zh: : 我很好。不过我的裤子好像越来越紧了。

lines.en: : Do you need any help adjusting them? I have a sewing machine upstairs and we can-
lines.zh: : 需要帮忙改一改吗？我楼上有台缝纫机，我们可以——

lines.en: : Oh dear. It seems I’ve made my daughter quite angry.
lines.zh: : 哎呀。看来我把女儿惹得很生气。

lines.en: : Oh! I know! How about the two of you take a little time off and go for a walk in the park?
lines.zh: : 哦！有了！你们俩就放个小假，去公园散散步怎么样？

lines.en: : Wait, seriously? I can take the night off?
lines.zh: : 等等，真的吗？我今晚可以休息？

lines.en: : Are you going to be okay here by yourself?
lines.zh: : 你一个人在这里没问题吗？

lines.en: : Also, as my mother, shouldn’t you be preventing me from walking around in the dark with a man who just openly admitted to having an erection?
lines.zh: : 还有，作为我妈，你不是该阻止我在天黑后、和一个刚刚公然承认自己勃起了的男人出去逛吗？

lines.en: : Hey, all I said was that my pants were getting tighter. Get your mind out of the gutter, Makoto.
lines.zh: : 喂，我只说我的裤子变紧了。别想歪了，Makoto。

lines.en: : I’m not worried. You’re a responsible girl and won’t let anything bad happen. I know you can hold your own out there if he tries anything.
lines.zh: : 我不担心。你是个有分寸的女孩，不会让坏事发生。我知道就算他动手动脚，你也能应付。
: 哦……嗯，是啊。

lines.en: : Yeah, I can hold my own. I’ll be okay.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我能应付。我不会有事的。

lines.en: : Besides, I think you might be a liiiiiittle too [young]for Sensei, dear~
lines.zh: : 再说了，亲爱的，我觉得你对老师来说可能[young]了那么一点点~

lines.en: I’m not even going to get involved in this part of the discussion.
lines.zh: 这部分讨论我可不想掺和。
: 怎么了，亲爱的？

lines.en: : Take this stupid dildo out of my hands so I can go for a walk with my teacher.
lines.zh: : 把我手里这根破假阳具拿走，好让我跟老师去散步。
: 好的，亲爱的~

lines.en: Looks like I didn’t even need to worry about getting involved since the conversation resolved on its own.
lines.zh: 看来我根本不用担心要掺和，这场对话自己就解决了。

lines.en: I guess there’s no one out there better at dealing with Maki than the girl who’s been answering to her nonsense for the last...however many years Makoto has been alive for.
lines.zh: 大概没人比这个……忍了 Maki 那些胡话整整 Makoto 出生以来这么多年的女孩，更擅长应付 Maki 了。

lines.en: The two of us exit the porn shop and make our way to the same park where we bumped into each other quite some time ago.
lines.zh: 我们俩走出色情用品店，走向那个我们很久以前曾偶然相遇的公园。

lines.en: Makoto shivers and sneaks closer to me, thinking I don’t notice when, in all actuality, it’s pretty obvious.
lines.zh: Makoto 打了个哆嗦，悄悄往我身边靠，以为我没注意到——实际上明显得很。

lines.en: It’s a little funny how she can go from business-Makoto to fun and cute Makoto at the drop of a hat.
lines.zh: 她能一转眼就从「公事公办的 Makoto」变成「好玩又可爱的 Makoto」，还挺好笑的。

lines.en: But I guess being alone with the person you admire is an understandable trigger.
lines.zh: 不过，和自己仰慕的人独处，会是这种导火索也情有可原。

lines.en: Eventually, we wind up on a park bench drowned in the glow of a dying streetlight and bring up the one thing that’s likely been on both of our minds since I walked in tonight.
lines.zh: 最后，我们坐在一张被昏黄路灯光淹没的公园长椅上，聊起了自我今晚进门起大概就一直挂在我俩心头的那件事。

lines.en: : So, how does it feel not being a virgin anymore? Any different?
lines.zh: : 那么，不再是处女了是什么感觉？有什么不同吗？

lines.en: : Not as different as I thought it would feel. I’m happy we went through with it, though.
lines.zh: : 没有我想象中那么不同。不过我很高兴我们做了。

lines.en: : You mean how you basically blackmailed me into deflowering you while you were drunk?
lines.zh: : 你是说你趁喝醉，基本算是勒索我、逼我破了你的身？

lines.en: : I did what I had to do, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 我是不得已而为之，老师。

lines.en: : If I left it up to you, you’d have probably held off until I was in college. I don’t have that kind of time.
lines.zh: : 要是交给你决定，你大概会一直拖到我上大学。我可没那么多时间。

lines.en: : You definitely do have that kind of time, though.
lines.zh: : 可你明明有那么多时间啊。

lines.en: : Also, you’re giving me way more credit than I deserve. At best, I only had a month left in me before I pulled the plug anyway.
lines.zh: : 而且你把我想得太有定力了。往好里说，我顶多也就再撑一个月就会收手。

lines.en: : Hmm...I guess you don’t have as much restraint as I thought you did, then.
lines.zh: : 嗯……看来你的自制力没我想的那么强。
: 显然不强，邪恶女巫。

lines.en: : I kept the costume. Want me to wear it again sometime?
lines.zh: : 那套服装我还留着。要我改天再穿一次吗？

lines.en: : Every day for the rest of your life, please.
lines.zh: : 请你的余生每天都穿。

lines.en: : Uhh...No. That’s not going to happen.
lines.zh: : 呃……不行。那不可能。
: 一周一次？

lines.en: : Closer but that’s still a little excessive.
lines.zh: : 接近了，不过还是有点过分。

lines.en: : I’m glad to hear you liked it so much, though.
lines.zh: : 不过听你这么喜欢，我挺高兴的。

lines.en: : Yeah. You’re cute {i}with{/i} glasses, but without them it’s like...a whole different type of monster.
lines.zh: : 嗯。你{i}戴{/i}眼镜很可爱，可不戴的话就像是……另一种完全不同的怪物。

lines.en: : Unfortunately, that monster comes at the cost of not being able to see anything.
lines.zh: : 可惜，那只怪物的代价是什么都看不见。
: 你没有隐形眼镜吗？

lines.en: : I do, but...I can’t put them in. My eyes get all watery every time I try and it’s a whole thing.
lines.zh: : 有，可是……我自己戴不进去。每次一试着戴眼睛就直流泪，麻烦得要命。

lines.en: : So right now, I’m pretty blind to tell you the truth. I can barely make out your face.
lines.zh: : 所以说实话，我现在基本是个瞎子。你的脸我几乎看不清。
: 那万圣节派对那次呢？

lines.en: : Oh, I had them in for that. But Miku had to hold my arms down while my mom put them in for me. It sucked.
lines.zh: : 哦，那次戴着呢。可 Miku 得按住我的胳膊，让我妈给我戴进去。烦死了。

lines.en: : Well I’ll be damned. Makoto Miyamura has a weakness after all.
lines.zh: : 哎呀，没想到。Makoto Miyamura 原来也有弱点。

lines.en: : I have plenty of weaknesses. I just don’t want anyone to know about them.
lines.zh: : 我的弱点多了去了。我只是不想让任何人知道。
: 那可不健康。
: 是啊，真的不健康。

lines.en: : It’s fine to talk, you know? My office is open at any time.
lines.zh: : 说出来也没关系的，你知道吧？我的办公室随时敞开。
: 你是说你的按摩院？

lines.en: : Really depends on the client, to tell the truth.
lines.zh: : 说实话，那得看客人是谁。

lines.en: : Don’t even worry about it, Sensei. None of my problems are that serious compared to some of the other girls.
lines.zh: : 老师你别担心。跟其他一些女孩比起来，我的烦恼根本不算什么。

lines.en: : Miku’s like Pandora’s Box once you start reading into her. But that’s something you’ll have to hear from her instead of me.
lines.zh: : Miku 一旦你深入了解，就像个潘多拉魔盒。不过那事你得听她说，不该由我来讲。
: 那我能从你这儿听到点{i}什么{/i}吗？

lines.en: : Not just about Miku or the other girls, but yourself.
lines.zh: : 不只是关于 Miku 或其他女孩，而是关于你自己。

lines.en: Makoto stays silent for a moment, looking deeply into my eyes and trying to figure out if she wants to talk or not.
lines.zh: Makoto 沉默了片刻，深深望进我的眼睛，试图判断自己想不想说。

lines.en: : Wanna hear about what happened after you left me on Halloween?
lines.zh: : 想听听万圣节那晚你离开我之后发生了什么吗？
: ……我想听吗？

lines.en: : I don’t like how you lead into that.
lines.zh: : 我不喜欢你这个开场方式。

lines.en: : Why? Worried someone found me covered in Sensei-juice?
lines.zh: : 为什么？怕有人发现我浑身沾满老师的汁液？
: 说实话，非常怕。

lines.en: : I thought about it on the way home, but I probably shouldn’t have just...left like that.
lines.zh: : 我在回家的路上想过了，但我大概不该就这么……丢下你走了。

lines.en: : Probably not. But you did and that’s okay.
lines.zh: : 大概是不该。不过你确实走了，那也没关系。

lines.en: : I wasn’t expecting you to spend the rest of the night with me, especially after I passed out.
lines.zh: : 我本来也没指望你陪我过完那一夜，尤其在我昏过去之后。
: 那么……是谁发现了你？
: 你真想知道？
: 就……告诉我吧，Makoto。

lines.en: My heart drops as she prepares to tell me how things ended up that night.
lines.zh: 她正要说出那晚的结局，我的心往下一沉。

lines.en: The best case scenario would be someone like Futaba who probably wouldn’t share something so...intense.
lines.zh: 最好的情况是被 Futaba 那样的人发现，她大概不会把这么……劲爆的事说出去。

lines.en: But the worst case scenario would probably be Ami or Ayane or-
lines.zh: 可最糟的情况大概就是 Ami、或者 Ayane，或者——
: Ayane……
: ……家的管家。
: 哦我操。

lines.en: : Hehehe~ Had you going there, didn’t I?
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿嘿~ 骗到你了吧？
: 你真恶毒。

lines.en: : Consider that payback for harassing me at work all the time.
lines.zh: : 这就当是你老在我上班时骚扰我的报应。

lines.en: : You think doing this is going to make me stop?
lines.zh: : 你以为这样我就会收手？

lines.en: : Probably not, but it's worth a shot.
lines.zh: : 大概不会，不过值得一试。

lines.en: : What did Geoffrey say? I thought he was supposed to be sick in bed or something.
lines.zh: : Geoffrey 说了什么？他不是应该卧病在床之类的吗？

lines.en: : That’s the weird part. He didn’t say anything.
lines.zh: : 怪就怪在这儿。他什么都没说。

lines.en: : He just stood in the doorway and turned around while I straightened myself out.
lines.zh: : 他就站在门口，然后转身背过去，等我整理好衣服。

lines.en: : I don’t even think he saw anything, to be honest. He probably just thought I was passed out from drinking too much.
lines.zh: : 说实话，我觉得他什么都没看见。他大概只当我是喝多了昏过去了。

lines.en: : It’s not like I was still exposed or anything. And the way I limped out of there could have probably just been chalked up to, again, alcohol.
lines.zh: : 我那时候也没走光什么的。而且我一瘸一拐走出去的样子，大概也能归结为——还是酒。

lines.en: : This might just be the single most convenient thing that has ever happened to me.
lines.zh: : 这大概是我这辈子遇过的最走运的一件事了。

lines.en: : Probably. God only knows what would have happened if someone closer to you found me in that state.
lines.zh: : 大概吧。天知道要是跟你更亲近的人撞见我那副样子会怎样。

lines.en: : Knowing we disappeared together would have probably led to all sorts of rumors, huh?
lines.zh: : 知道我们一起消失，大概会引来各种流言吧？
: 是啊……

lines.en: Something about the way she says that makes me uneasy.
lines.zh: 她说这话的某种语气让我不安。

lines.en: It’s a confusing tone I haven’t ever heard from Makoto before- almost like she {i}wanted{/i} something like that to happen.
lines.zh: 那是种我从没在 Makoto 身上听到过的、令人费解的语气——几乎像是她{i}希望{/i}那种事发生。

lines.en: She wouldn’t do that, would she?
lines.zh: 她不会那么做的，对吧？

lines.en: : Umm...I didn’t get to really say it back then, but-
lines.zh: : 嗯……那次我没能好好说出口，不过——
: 谢谢……

lines.en: : For finally having sex with me.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你终于跟我做了。

lines.en: : I really, {i}really{/i} needed to get that out of my system. And there’s no one else I would have rather done it with other than you.
lines.zh: : 我真的、{i}真的{/i}需要把它发泄出来。而除了你，我不想跟任何人做这件事。
: 或者 Ryan Gosling 也行。
: 不，说真的，绝对是 Ryan Gosling。

lines.en: : But you were a close second.
lines.zh: : 不过你排第二，差得不多。

lines.en: : Who is this Ryan guy and where can I find him?
lines.zh: : 这个 Ryan 是谁，我去哪儿能找到他？

lines.en: : Hollywood, probably. Wanna catch a flight there when the borders open back up?
lines.zh: : 大概在好莱坞吧。等边境重开，要不要搭飞机过去？
: 我会一个人去。谢了。
: 是为捍卫我的荣誉而战吗？
: 是为捍卫我的女巫而战。

lines.en: : Aaaand we're back at the witch costume, huh?...
lines.zh: : 然、后又绕回女巫装了是吧？……

lines.en: : You really like that thing, don’t you?
lines.zh: : 你真的很喜欢那套衣服，对吧？
: 你根本想象不到，Makoto。
: 你根本想象不到。

lines.en: We leave the park shortly after that and, get this, {i}hold hands{/i} for a block or two.
lines.zh: 之后没多久我们就离开了公园，而且——猜怎么着——我们{i}手牵手{/i}走了一两个街区。

lines.en: Obviously, Makoto is the one who initiates it. But feeling bad about the aftermath of what transpired on Halloween, I let it happen.
lines.zh: 显然，是 Makoto 先牵的。不过想到万圣节那件事的后续，我有些过意不去，就由着她了。

lines.en: It feels good making her happy every once in a while.
lines.zh: 偶尔让她开心一下，感觉也不错。

lines.en: I can just never tell if the happiness is superficial or not.
lines.zh: 我只是永远分不清那份快乐是不是浮于表面。
她……有时候意外地让人捉摸不透。

lines.en: But I guess that’s just what you get when you wind up sleeping with someone smarter than you.
lines.zh: 不过，跟一个比你聪明的人睡到一起，大概就是这样。
{i}Makoto 的好感度提升到了 [makoto_love]！{/i}
